edits.before: Q off minions to chip the duo — the angles are the lane and every wave drops souls.
edits.after: Even early — her engage is short-range and telegraphed, so poke with Q and keep your ADC out of a double-hit angle.

edits.before: Soul discipline begins: collect what's safe; the range grows forever.
edits.after: Your poke matches her telegraphed early trades — deny the mount stun by spacing.

edits.before: W threats open: any clumped trade risks the spreading root.
edits.after: Still even — you keep out-poking her before her engage tools come fully online.

edits.before: Chip the ledger and bank the souls — the collection out-scales every support item.
edits.after: You still out-poke her here, but her combo opens with an auto-reset off Full Tilt — the wind-up is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Dawning Shadow online — the global beam saves dives and finishes recalls.
edits.after: Magnet Storm (R) pulls you and your ADC together for a guaranteed follow-up — your global R can't peel a pull.

edits.before: First item: the Q chunks and the soul thresholds start mocking trade math.
edits.after: Her tanky build and permanent mounted engage let her walk your poke and lock down whoever she dashes onto.

edits.before: Late Senna out-ranges the game from the support slot — souls, beams, and mist.
edits.after: You scale too, but her R pull and CC chain keep her favoured whenever she lands the engage.

edits.before: - Rell Crash Down: matchup-defining — The mount-crash knockup starts her chain — respect the dismount range. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Curse of the Black Mist banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Crash Down (W) is a 10s dash that shields her — force it out before you commit burst. Her combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Full Tilt, E) — the wind-up is your cue to step back. Magnet Storm (R) is 120/100/80s and pulls two targets together.
